تختصرون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَصِرُونَ (taḵtaṣirūna) /tax.ta.sˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# تُخْتَصَرُونَ (tuḵtaṣarūna) /tux.ta.sˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
